title: Consultant - oil & gas
description: Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward. In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else. When you join us, you will have: Continuous learning:  Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey. A voice that matters:  From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes. Global community:  With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences. World-class benefits:  On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family. Your colleagues at Mc Kinsey will go to extraordinary lengths to ensure your success. You will have the opportunity to assist, learn from, challenge, and be challenged by leaders. We will constantly invest in your personal development through daily coaching and mentoring coupled with comprehensive training programs that begin soon after you join and continue throughout your Mc Kinsey career.   You will work in teams of typically 3–5 consultants, playing an active role in all aspects of client engagement. You will help clients to change industries, transform business models, and create competitive advantages. We advise some of the largest, most innovative companies in a variety of industries, including oil and gas, metals and mining, telecommunications, retail, banking and finance. As part of your daily work you will gather and analyze information, formulating and testing hypotheses, and developing and communicating recommendations. You will present results to client management and implement recommendations in collaboration with client team members. You will receive exceptional training as well as frequent coaching and mentoring from colleagues on their teams. You will also receive close guidance and support from your local office or practice in the selection of client projects, helping you to develop your skills and build your network. Bachelor's degree and/or Masters, MBA, Ph D with Engineering background (Chemical, Geology, Geoscience, Industrial) Proven experience in upstream Oil and Gas operations, including exploration, production, and reservoir management  Exceptional problem-solving skills with the ability to untangle complex issues Strong logical reasoning and creative thinking skills Quantitative aptitude Ability to take initiative and eagerness to break new ground, create opportunities for others, and take personal risks Native Portuguese, advanced English skills (fluent in writing and speaking)

description:

description: O Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle  nasce da união de dois gigantes da moda brasileira: Grupo SOMA e AR&CO . O Grupo SOMA era responsável por desenvolver e consolidar marcas que ajudaram a fortalecer a moda e cultura brasileira, como Animale, FARM Rio, Fábula, Maria Filó, NV, CRIS BARROS, Carol Bassi, Foxton e OFF PREMIUM. Já a AR&Co era a plataforma de marcas super desejadas, como Reserva, Reserva Mini, Oficina, Reserva Go e INK. Com a união entre Grupo SOMA e Arezzo&Co e a consequente criação da holding Azzas 2154, o Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle  passou a ser a unidade de negócios responsável pelas marcas de vestuário feminino e masculino da plataforma . É assim surge o nosso propósito: impulsionar o poder criativo da moda brasileira para o mundo. Hoje, reunimos marcas que constroem e levam a moda brasileira para o Brasil e para o mundo: Animale, Carol Bassi, CRIS BARROS, FARM Etc, FARM Rio, Fábula, Foxton, INK, Maria Filó, NV, Oficina, OFF PREMIUM, Reserva, Reserva Go e Reserva Mini. Mais do que marcas fortes e conhecidas, somos feitos de pessoas . Aqui, gente boa e do bem sonha grande e faz gigante! title: Business analyst
description: Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward. In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. When you join us, you will have: Continuous learning:  Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes. Global community:  With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences. World-class benefits:  On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family. As a business analyst, you will join a client service team and take ownership of a workstream to solve some of the toughest challenges our clients face. And these aren’t just any clients—they're some of the most influential organizations around, from Fortune 500 giants to innovative startups. title: [banco de talentos] coordenador(a) de transmissões (rj)
description: O que nos move A paixão por esportes é indiscutível, mas o que realmente nos move é a inovação constante. Requisitos necessários: Ter experiência em coordenação de transmissões e eventos esportivos ao vivo , com domínio de dinâmica, ritmo e timing de jogo (momentos-chave, reatividade a breaking news e construção de narrativa no ar); Ter vivência prática em planejar e executar o roteiro operacional do ao vivo , transformando pauta/ideia em plano executável (pré-jogo, jogo e pós-jogo) com materiais, arquivos e combinados organizados; Ter capacidade de atuar sob pressão e decidir rápido , mantendo comunicação objetiva e priorização durante o ao vivo; Ter habilidade de coordenação transversal , alinhando múltiplas áreas e garantindo clareza de responsabilidades e entregas; Ter excelente comunicação e repertório editorial , apoiando talentos e sustentando uma cobertura consistente e envolvente; Ter experiência com switcher , atuando na coordenação do ao vivo e contribuindo para timing, entradas e execução em tempo real. Diferenciais desejáveis: Ter participado de coberturas complexas e formatos inovadores , ajudando a construir linguagem e rotinas escaláveis de transmissão; Ter experiência em projetos com marcas e entregas comerciais , equilibrando narrativa editorial com compromissos de patrocínio; Ter familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas à produção , usando para pesquisa, roteiros, organização de informações, checagem e produtividade. É permitida a inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com custos por conta do colaborador e mesma coparticipação. Plano Odontológico (Mais DOC)  sem custo mensal para o colaborador para o plano "Mais Doc", com possibilidade de migração para outros planos (diferença de valor descontada em folha) e inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com desconto em folha. Nossa cultura Na Live Mode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte , e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES ontem, hoje e sempre.SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE , não uma família.SOMOS AMBICIOSOS , pensamos sempre grande.O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO , com tecnologia e IA no centro do jogo.

Nossa missão é fornecer consultoria especializada e interdisciplinar em meio ambiente, gerenciamento de riscos e em todo o ciclo de vida de potenciais emergências e crises, agregando sustentabilidade e resiliência as operações de nossos clientes. Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor com experiência em segurança de processos e gestão de riscos para atuar em projetos de consultoria técnica diversificada, atendendo empresas de grande porte, principalmente do segmento de óleo e gás. Você fará parte de uma equipe técnica multidisciplinar e terá a oportunidade de contribuir com diagnósticos, avaliações e implementação de práticas voltadas à melhoria da segurança operacional e prevenção de acidentes industriais. Requisitos: Formação em Engenharia (preferencialmente Química, de Processos, Mecânica ou afins); Experiência de, no mínimo, 5 anos com segurança de processos industriais; Conhecimento prático em ferramentas de análise de risco e normas aplicáveis (SGSO, API, CCPS, entre outras); Boa capacidade de comunicação técnica, escrita e oral; Certificação em metodologia de análise de riscos (ex: facilitador HAZOP); Experiência com softwares de modelagem de riscos (ex: PHA-Pro, Bow Tie XP, DNV Phast). title: Marketing executive assistant (ai-enabled operator)
description: Who Are We? Decentralized Masters is at the forefront of De Fi education globally. Our Vision Our goal is to create the largest and most influential De Fi ecosystem the world has ever seen… powered not just by talent, but by intelligent systems, automation, and AI-driven leverage. As we continue to scale rapidly, the Head of Growth requires a highly capable Executive Assistant to help manage operations, optimize workflows, and integrate AI tools to dramatically increase execution velocity. What Will You Be Doing? The Executive Assistant to the Head of Growth will act as a force multiplier. You will manage day-to-day operations, streamline communication across departments, support marketing execution, and implement AI-powered systems to increase efficiency. This is not a passive administrative role - this is an execution-focused, high-responsibility position working directly with leadership. You will sit at the center of marketing, growth, product, and executive operations. Key Responsibilities 1. Executive & Calendar Management Manage CMO’s calendar, priorities, and daily execution cadence Coordinate cross-functional meetings and ensure alignment Prepare agendas, capture action items, and enforce follow-ups Anticipate bottlenecks and proactively remove friction 2. Team & Project Coordination Track marketing projects across departments (copy, creative, growth, product) Ensure deadlines are met and stakeholders are aligned Maintain dashboards and visibility into team KPIs Assist with hiring coordination and onboarding processes 3. AI & Systems Implementation Leverage AI tools (Chat GPT, Notion AI, automation platforms, etc.) to streamline workflows Build SOPs and documentation using AI Identify manual processes that can be automated Assist in implementing low-code/no-code systems to reduce operational overhead 4. Marketing Execution Support Assist with campaign coordination (webinars, launches, email campaigns, ads) QA marketing assets before launch Manage internal communication between copy, design, media buyers, and leadership Help coordinate reporting cycles and weekly performance reviews 5. Personal & Administrative Support Assist with travel coordination, scheduling, and vendor management Support personal calendar organization and life logistics Help manage external communications and priority filtering Requirements What Do You Bring? Required Qualifications & Experience 2–4 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Marketing Coordinator, or Project Manager Strong organizational and time-management skills Comfortable working directly with senior leadership High proficiency with productivity tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Click Up, etc.) Strong comfort level using AI tools and automation software Excellent written and verbal communication skills Ability to prioritize, execute quickly, and operate in a fast-paced environment High ownership mindset — you solve problems without waiting for instructions Soft Skills & Traits Highly organized and detail-oriented Proactive and anticipatory Calm under pressure Structured thinker Tech-savvy and curious about AI Discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information Comfortable in a remote-first, distributed team Benefits Compensation & Structure $3,000 - $5,000/month depending on experience Full-time (40 hours per week) Remote (work from anywhere) High growth trajectory, potential to evolve into a Marketing Operations Manager with Performance Bonuses. What Do We Offer You? Direct access to executive leadership Fast-paced, high-growth environment Unlimited PTO Flexible schedule Team off-sites Remote-first culture across 30+ countries If you are highly organized, execution-driven, and excited about using AI to amplify leadership impact we want to hear from you.

title: Estágio em contabilidade

title: Project manager - client onboarding, transition & offboarding
description: Role Summary Avanto provides complex BPO and technical professional services, and our clients rely on us to seamlessly integrate into their business operations. We are seeking a highly capable, consultative Project Manager to serve as the strategic bridge between our sales team, our internal delivery teams, and our new clients. We are looking for individuals who are comfortable working in an environment where processes are continuously evolving, and where technology including AI, is used to drive better outcomes. This is not a back-office administrative role, and we are not looking for someone to just check boxes on a tracker. We need a delivery leader who deeply understands BPO and technical services, acting as a trusted advisor to our clients from the moment a deal closes through a successful go-live. You will architect their onboarding experience, translate their technical and business requirements into operational realities, and drive external projects with authority, high emotional intelligence, and discipline. Key Responsibilities Consultative Client Onboarding & Delivery Act as a Strategic Guide: Lead the end-to-end onboarding process for new client engagements. Leverage your understanding of Avanto's BPO and technical services to advise clients on best practices and steer them away from potential implementation pitfalls. Drive Kickoff & Alignment: Own the agenda and facilitate high-level external kickoff meetings. Ensure client executives and operational leaders are fully aligned on scope, technical requirements, workflows, and communication cadences. Manage Expectations & Scope: Act as the gatekeeper between the sales process and operational reality. Confidently manage client expectations to prevent scope creep during the onboarding phase. Technical & Operational Translation Bridge the Gap: Serve as the critical translator between the client's business needs and our internal operations and technical delivery teams. Validate Requirements: Ensure that all technical requirements, IT infrastructure needs, and outsourced operational workflows are thoroughly documented, understood by the client, and actionable for the Avanto team. Client Transition & Offboarding Manage Seamless Transitions: Architect structured transition and offboarding plans when client engagements evolve or conclude. Ensure Operational Readiness: Coordinate final knowledge transfer, documentation handoffs, and operational closure to guarantee a steady-state transition without disruption. Required Skills & Competencies Industry Acumen: Demonstrated ability to understand and speak confidently about BPO services, technical workflows, or IT infrastructure to both technical and non-technical external stakeholders. Consultative Polish: Exceptional external-facing presence. You must possess the emotional intelligence to navigate complex client dynamics, manage frustrations gracefully, and guide executives through operational change. Assertive Stakeholder Management: The ability to confidently set boundaries and guide client expectations while maintaining a premium service experience. Communication: Authoritative written and verbal communication. You command a room during client kickoffs and executive check-ins. Project Management Tools: Strong experience building out transparent client-facing project trackers in tools like Jira, Notion, or similar platforms. Experience leveraging automation or AI tools to improve workflows is preferred Experience & Qualifications Experience: 3–6 years of client-facing project management or implementation experience. Industry Background: Required experience working within a BPO, Managed Services Provider (MSP), or Technical Professional Services environment. Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations, Project Management, or a related field. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Time-to-Value: Average time required to successfully onboard new clients and achieve operational readiness. Client Satisfaction (CSAT): Client feedback scores specifically related to the onboarding and implementation experience. Scope Fidelity: Minimization of out-of-scope requests or undocumented changes during the implementation phase. Implementation Quality: Successful transition of clients into steady-state operations with zero post-launch disruption. Salary: $1,500- 2,000 USD

Requisitos e qualificações Habilidades e Conhecimentos: • Conectar, engajar e inspirar ativamente os consumidores. • Habilidades interpessoais e comunicacionais, incluindo a capacidade de gerenciar situações que envolvam consumidores. • Capacidade de demonstrar agilidade e responsividade ao executar as tarefas e processos da loja. • Transpor o conhecimento à execução do retail, o que contribuirá para garantir que a estratégia e os processos globais da marca sejam executados nas lojas de retail, gerando processos operacionais de excelência nas lojas. • Comunicar um desejo de aprendizado contínuo e acolher todas as oportunidades disponíveis para aumentar as performances própria e da loja através da compreensão do ambiente de retail, dos produtos, do conhecimento da marca e do comportamento do consumidor. Cursando Administração, Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda ou áreas correlatas; Boa comunicação verbal e escrita; Perfil analítico, organizado e proativo; Facilidade com planejamento e acompanhamento de atividades; Interesse por vendas, comportamento do consumidor e performance digital; Conhecimento em Excel/Google Sheets será considerado diferencial; Experiência ou contato com plataforma de marketplace são um diferencial.  /n
Cadastro de anúncios nos marketplaces; Interface com parceiros; Gestão e atualização dos portais de marketplaces; Análise de sortimento/cobertura; Auxílio na implementação de ações comerciais; Implementação de novos canais.

title: Technical recruiter (remote worldwide)
description: Reboot Monkey is a global datacenter services provider. We don’t just need a recruiter; we need a Technical Scout . You will be responsible for building and maintaining our world-class pool of Data Center Technicians (DCTs) and Data Engineers across 24 facilities. Your mission is to ensure that when a client needs "Smart Hands" or a data pipeline built, we have a vetted, reliable expert ready to go. You will go beyond keyword matching, you will conduct deep-dive technical screenings to verify hands-on expertise in structured cabling, hardware installs, and data architecture. Core Responsibilities: Sourcing: Proactively hunt for specialized DCTs and Data Engineers in multiple geographical regions. Technical Vetting: Conduct interviews to assess hands-on skills (e.g., rack/stack, labeling standards, hot/cold aisle management). Pool Management: Maintain a live database of vetted contractors categorized by location, skill level, and reliability score. Verification: Execute rigorous credential checks, including certifications and past work history. Reporting: Track technician performance post-deployment to ensure quality control. Experience: 2+ years of technical recruitment or talent acquisition specifically within IT Infrastructure, Cloud, or Data Centers. Technical IQ: Must understand physical infrastructure (PDUs, fiber types, server hardware) and data engineering fundamentals. Language: Full professional fluency in English (written and spoken). Logistics: Must be able to work consistently within different timezones. Tech Stack: Proficiency with Linked In Recruiter, ATS platforms, and advanced spreadsheet management (Google Sheets/Excel). Mindset: Highly organized with a "detective" approach to finding niche talent in emerging markets.

title: Analista de inovação júnior
description: Sobre a Evoltz Criada em 2018, a Evoltz é responsável pela operação de onze linhas de transmissão, totalizando 3.561km, passando por 10 estados do Brasil. A empresa é hoje uma plataforma operacional de ativos de transmissão de energia, apta a receber novos investimentos. Em 2021, a companhia alcançou um marco transformacional, momento em que a Ontario Teachers Pension Plan Board (“OTPP”), celebrou o acordo definitivo para aquisição de 100% da empresa. Cadastrar novos fornecedores para consultas e cotações, conforme necessário. Efetuar avaliação dos fornecedores, considerando performance e níveis de atendimento e serviço. Elaborar contratos de prestação de serviço e fornecimento de materiais, visando otimizar as negociações e gerando savings para a empresa. Seguir indicadores de performance da equipe, como também os individuais, a fim de buscar a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados. Requisitos: Formação de nível superior completa. Conhecimento de processos de licitação, importações e gerenciamento de contratos. Conhecimento de Pacote Office (Excel). Inglês Avançado. Diferencial: Conhecimento em Power BI. Experiência com compras em óleo e gás e/ou área naval. Pós-graduação na área.
